Social Image Size Guide

Every platform's recommended image sizes in one place — pick a network and placement, see exact pixels and a scaled preview.

PlacementSize (px)AspectPreview

Recommended sizes per platform documentation (2026). Preview boxes are scaled to true aspect ratio.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a platform (Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest).
  2. Pick a placement — post, story, profile, cover, thumbnail.
  3. Read the exact pixel size and aspect ratio; the preview box shows its true proportions.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where do these sizes come from?

They are the platforms' published recommended dimensions as of 2026. Networks occasionally tweak specs — when in doubt, upload larger and let the platform crop.

What if my image is a different size?

Platforms resize and center-crop to fit. Matching the recommended size avoids awkward auto-crops and keeps text sharp.

Why does aspect ratio matter more than pixels?

Feeds crop to a fixed ratio (e.g. 4:5 on Instagram). The preview box renders each size at its true aspect ratio so you can see the crop shape.
